injection_point: GroupAuthority.commit() loop after replica A, before replica B/C
root_cause: Q5 publication updates replicas sequentially in-memory without 2-phase commit or WAL. Because Q5 bypasses cluster.journal, self-healing controller cannot find missing group entries; Node A is quarantined as divergent, and Nodes B/C falsely report convergence to empty journal tip.

injection_point: Network isolation of Node C during group commit
root_cause: Because Q5 does not write to cluster.journal, prefix_index_for(C) returns 0 and journal is empty. heal_node incorrectly reports ALREADY_CONVERGED without replaying any transactions. Node C remains at sequence 0, causing subsequent commits to fail with DIVERGED.

injection_point: Coordinator restart (GroupAuthority re-instantiation)
root_cause: Q5 maintains self.applied purely in an in-memory set and leaves cluster.journal empty. Neither the coordinator nor the cluster persists committed group certificates or state to a WAL or disk.
